sentences.text:
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Subhash Chand
------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Avishek Prasad, Advocate For the State : Mr. Tarun Kumar, A.P.P.
--------
05/16th February, 2024
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2. As prayed for by the learned counsel for the petitioner, the defect no. 9(iv) is hereby ignored.

3. This second bail application has been filed on behalf of the abovenamed applicant with prayer to release on bail in connection with Namkum P.S. Case No.267 of 2021 under Sections 376(D) of the I.P.C. pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Ranchi.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that earlier prayer for bail of the petitioner was rejected by this Court vide order dated 9th June, 2022 passed in B.A. No.4040 of 2022.

By way of present bail application, the petitioner has renewed his prayer for bail, primarily for the reason that after rejection of the first bail application, the co-accused has been granted bail by this Court.
On this ground, learned counsel for the petitioner prayed that the petitioner may be given the privilege of regular bail.
5. Learned A.P.P. appearing on behalf of the State opposed the contentions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner.

From record, it appears that first bail application of the applicant was rejected on merits.
After rejection of the first bail application on merits, if any co-accused has been granted bail, the same cannot be taken into consideration at the time of disposal of second bail application.
7. In view of above discussions, no new ground for second bail application is made out.

Accordingly,
the same is, hereby, rejected.
